subject: Future Tech
title: Affordable Housing Crisis
description: Learn Affordable Housing Crisis in one minute.

hook.text: 1.6 billion people worldwide lack adequate housing.

buildup.text: New Story and ICON printed a community of homes in rural Mexico in 2020.

discovery.text: These homes withstood local earthquakes and storms.

twist.text: Land, permits, and infrastructure cost more than the house itself.

climax.text: African and South Asian governments explore printed housing to shelter millions at a speed bricks cannot match.

punchline.text: A $10,000 printed home could shelter a family displaced for decades.

quiz.question: How much did each 3D-printed home in Mexico cost?
